## Checklist

- [ ] `desc` < 80 chars
- [ ] `homepage` is HTTPS
- [ ] `license` uses a SPDX identifier
- [ ] At least one non-trivial `test do` block
- [ ] `brew audit --new --strict --online <formula>` passes
- [ ] `brew style <formula>` passes
